Name: rikai's Seasonal Overgrown Greenhouse
Author: r1kai
Description:
[center][url=https://get.rekd.net/]Discord [/url][b]|[/b] [url=https://twitter.com/rikailp]Twitter[/url] [b]|[/b] [url=https://youtube.com/@rikailp]Youtube[/url] [b]|[/b] [url=https://twitch.tv/rikailp]Twitch[/url] [b]|[/b] [url=https://ko-fi.com/rikai]Ko-Fi[/url]

This is a greatly expanded version of the Really Big Greenhouse for Raffadax variant of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4280]Pookachu's Seasonal Greenhouse[/url] posted with permission from Pookachu.

Please feel free to join the [url=https://get.rekd.net/]Discord[/url] if you require any support or even just want to hang out![/center]

To give a sense of the scale of this version, here's a brief rundown of the plantable area:

Tree Planters: 432
5x5 Planters: 176
3x8 Planter: 20
2x29 planters 8
3x49 planters: 4
57x3 planters: 4

[b][u]Recommended Mods[/u][/b]

* Tractor Mod
* Automate
* Autograbber
* The full PPJA pack and every other crop/fruit tree mod under the sun probably.

[b][u]Installation[/u][/b]
Installs just like any other mod.

To uninstall, just make sure the greenhouse is emptied to make sure you don't lose anything, and then uninstall the mod as normal.

Downloads.Description: Minor update to the manifest to fix the update check as well as some folder changes.
